decision: Revisit Tier 1 business-bundle target bracket ($29-$49/mo in PRICING.md). External comps captured today cluster into two bands with a trough across Vrooli's target: (a) solo dev-tool / bundle: Setapp $10-15, Notion Plus $10, Cursor Pro $20, Copilot Pro $10, Raycast Pro $8; (b) prosumer AI-forward dev tool: Copilot Pro+ $39, Cursor Pro+ $60. The $29-$49 bracket sits in the middle with no strong anchor. Recommend operator choose a positioning: 'premium multi-app bundle' ($15-25 range) or 'prosumer AI dev-suite' ($39-59 range). The trough is only a problem if buyers pattern-match to the wrong category.
rationale: Pricing trough is a real signal — not prescriptive, but actionable. Positioning drives price, not the other way around. The closest strict multi-app-bundle comp (Setapp) tops out at $15 standard / $24 AI+. The closest prosumer AI dev-tool (Cursor Pro+, Copilot Pro+) sits at $39-60. $29-$49 asks buyers to bridge those categories narratively. Raising so operator weighs positioning question explicitly at vision walk. Not setting a price — just flagging the gap.
